const scale := 4096

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int mul(int first, int second)
    return floor_div(first * second, scale)

int isqrt(int value)
    low := 0
    high := 1
    while high * high <= value
        high *= 2
    while low + 1 < high
        middle := (low + high) / 2
        if middle * middle <= value
            low = middle
        else
            high = middle
    return low

import fixed = "./fixed_point.qui"
import vector = "./vector3.qui"

int[] slab(int[] low, int[] high, int[] origin, int[] direction)
    near := 0
    far := 0
    near_axis := -1
    far_axis := -1
    for: axis < 3
        component := direction[axis]
        if component == 0
            if origin[axis] < low[axis] or origin[axis] > high[axis]
                return []
        else
            a := fixed.floor_div((low[axis] - origin[axis]) * 4096, component)
            b := fixed.floor_div((high[axis] - origin[axis]) * 4096, component)
            entry := if a < b then a else b
            leave := if a > b then a else b
            if near_axis < 0 or entry > near
                near = entry
                near_axis = axis
            if far_axis < 0 or leave < far
                far = leave
                far_axis = axis
    return if near > far then [] else [near, near_axis, far, far_axis]

int[] candidate(string kind, int[] geometry, int[] origin, int[] direction, int epsilon)
    if kind == "sphere"
        oc := vector.sub(origin, geometry[0:<3])
        b := vector.dot(oc, direction)
        center_t := fixed.floor_div(-b * 4096, vector.dot(direction, direction))
        h := vector.add(oc, vector.sc(direction, center_t))
        q := fixed.floor_div(geometry[3] * geometry[3], 4096) - vector.dot(h, h)
        if q < 0
            return []
        width := fixed.floor_div(fixed.isqrt(q * 4096) * 4096, vector.length(direction))
        distance := center_t - width
        if distance <= epsilon
            distance = center_t + width
        return if distance > epsilon then [distance, 0, -1] else []
    if kind == "plane"
        denominator := vector.dot(direction, geometry[3:<6])
        if denominator == 0
            return []
        distance := fixed.floor_div(vector.dot(vector.sub(geometry[0:<3], origin), geometry[3:<6]) * 4096, denominator)
        return if distance > epsilon then [distance, 0, -1] else []
    interval := slab(geometry[0:<3], geometry[3:<6], origin, direction)
    if #interval == 0
        return []
    if interval[0] > epsilon
        return [interval[0], 1, interval[1]]
    if interval[2] > epsilon
        return [interval[2], 0, interval[3]]
    return []

int[] outward(string kind, int[] geometry, int[] point, int[] direction, int[] hit)
    if kind == "sphere"
        return vector.norm(vector.sub(point, geometry[0:<3]))
    if kind == "plane"
        return geometry[3:<6]
    axis := hit[2]
    sign := if direction[axis] > 0 then 1 else -1
    if hit[1] == 1
        sign = -sign
    result := [0, 0, 0]
    result[axis] = sign * 4096
    return result

int[][] bounds(string kind, int[] geometry, int margin)
    if kind == "plane"
        return []
    int[] low := []
    int[] high := []
    for: axis < 3
        low = low.append(if kind == "sphere" then geometry[axis] - geometry[3] - margin else geometry[axis] - margin)
        high = high.append(if kind == "sphere" then geometry[axis] + geometry[3] + margin else geometry[axis + 3] + margin)
    return [low, high]

import fixed = "./fixed_point.qui"
import vector = "./vector3.qui"
import scene = "./scene.qui"
import intersect = "./intersect.qui"
import shading = "./shading.qui"

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

string words(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1((if #rows == 0 then "" else rows.join(NL) + NL))

class Settings(local string[][] rows)
    int width := scene.integer(rows[0][1])
    int height := scene.integer(rows[0][2])
    int contrast := scene.integer(rows[1][1])
    int max_depth := scene.integer(rows[2][1])
    int far := scene.integer(rows[3][1])
    int epsilon := scene.integer(rows[4][1])
    int margin := scene.integer(rows[5][1])

Settings read_settings()
    rows := [for row := read_lines("input/render.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    return Settings(rows)

class Node(int[] low, int[] high, int depth, int[] objects)
    left := -1
    right := -1
    visits := 0

class Info(int object_index, int distance, int[] point, int[] normal, bool front, int[] base)
    int[][] lighting := []
    illumination := 0

Info empty_info()
    return Info(-1, 0, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], true, [0, 0, 0])

class Pixel(int x, int y)
    rays := 0
    depth := 0
    samples := 1
    label := "."
    center := [0, 0, 0]
    color := [0, 0, 0]
    hit := empty_info()

class Renderer(scene.Scene data, Settings settings)
    int[][][] object_bounds := []
    int[] leaf_depths := []
    int[] planes := []
    Node[] nodes := []
    root := -1
    rays := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    misses := [0, 0, 0]
    int[] depth_counts := [for depth := (0:<(int(settings.max_depth) + 1))[] then 0]
    int[][] tests := [[0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0]]
    int[][] object_counts := [for j := (0:<int(#data.objects))[] then [0, 0, 0]]
    int[][] light_counts := [for j := (0:<int(#data.lights))[] then [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]]
    total_internal := 0
    clamped := 0
    supersampled := 0
    Pixel[] pixels := []

    int[][] union_box(int[] members)
        low := object_bounds[members[0]][0]
        high := object_bounds[members[0]][1]
        for index := members[]
            for: axis < 3
                low[axis] = minimum(low[axis], object_bounds[index][0][axis])
                high[axis] = maximum(high[axis], object_bounds[index][1][axis])
        return [low, high]

    int surface_cost(int[] members)
        int[][] bounds := union_box(members)
        delta := vector.sub(bounds[1], bounds[0])
        return (delta[0] * delta[1] + delta[1] * delta[2] + delta[2] * delta[0]) * int(#members)

    int[] axis_order(int[] members, int axis)
        int[] result := []
        for index := members[]
            center := fixed.floor_div(object_bounds[index][0][axis] + object_bounds[index][1][axis], 2)
            int[] updated := []
            added := false
            for previous := result[]
                previous_center := fixed.floor_div(object_bounds[previous][0][axis] + object_bounds[previous][1][axis], 2)
                if not added and (center < previous_center or (center == previous_center and index < previous))
                    updated = updated.append(index)
                    added = true
                updated = updated.append(previous)
            if not added
                updated = updated.append(index)
            result = updated
        return result

    int .build(int[] members, int depth)
        int[][] bounds := union_box(members)
        index := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(Node(bounds[0], bounds[1], depth, []))
        if #members <= 2
            nodes[index].objects = members.sorted()
            for object_index := members[]
                leaf_depths[object_index] = depth
            return index
        best_cost := -1
        int[] best_left := []
        int[] best_right := []
        for: axis < 3
            int[] ordered := axis_order(members, axis)
            for: 1 <= split < int(#ordered)
                left := ordered[0:<split]
                right := ordered[split:<int(#ordered)]
                int cost := surface_cost(left) + surface_cost(right)
                if best_cost < 0 or cost < best_cost
                    best_cost = cost
                    best_left = left
                    best_right = right
        int left := .build(best_left, depth + 1)
        int right := .build(best_right, depth + 1)
        nodes[index].left = left
        nodes[index].right = right
        return index

    void .prepare()
        int[] bounded := []
        for: index < int(#data.objects)
            scene.Object object := data.objects[index]
            bounds := intersect.bounds(object.kind, object.geometry, settings.margin)
            object_bounds = object_bounds.append(bounds)
            leaf_depths = leaf_depths.append(-1)
            if #bounds > 0
                bounded = bounded.append(index)
            else
                planes = planes.append(index)
        if #bounded > 0
            root = .build(bounded, 0)

    int[] .test_node(int index, int[] origin, int[] direction, int kind, bool counted)
        if counted
            tests[kind][0] += 1
            nodes[index].visits += 1
        interval := intersect.slab(nodes[index].low, nodes[index].high, origin, direction)
        if #interval == 0 or interval[2] <= settings.epsilon
            return []
        return interval

    int[] .test_object(int index, int[] origin, int[] direction, int kind, bool counted)
        if counted
            tests[kind][1] += 1
        scene.Object object := data.objects[index]
        return intersect.candidate(object.kind, object.geometry, origin, direction, settings.epsilon)

    void .consider(int index, int[] origin, int[] direction, int kind, bool counted, int &best_object, int[] &best_hit)
        int[] hit := .test_object(index, origin, direction, kind, counted)
        if #hit > 0 and hit[0] <= settings.far and (best_object < 0 or hit[0] < best_hit[0] or (hit[0] == best_hit[0] and index < best_object))
            best_object = index
            best_hit = hit

    (int, int[]) .nearest(int[] origin, int[] direction, int kind, bool counted)
        best_object := -1
        int[] best_hit := []
        for index := planes[]
            .consider(index, origin, direction, kind, counted, &best_object, &best_hit)
        int[] pending := if root >= 0 then [root] else []
        while #pending != 0
            last := int(#pending) - 1
            index := pending[last]
            pending = pending[0:<last]
            int[] interval := .test_node(index, origin, direction, kind, counted)
            if #interval == 0 or interval[0] > settings.far or (best_object >= 0 and interval[0] > best_hit[0])
                continue
            node := nodes[index]
            if #node.objects > 0
                for object_index := node.objects[]
                    .consider(object_index, origin, direction, kind, counted, &best_object, &best_hit)
            else
                pending = pending.append(node.right).append(node.left)
        return (best_object, best_hit)

    void .consider_occluder(int index, int[] origin, int[] direction, int distance, bool counted, int[] &found)
        int[] hit := .test_object(index, origin, direction, 3, counted)
        if #hit > 0 and hit[0] < distance
            found = found.append(index)
            if counted
                object_counts[index][2] += 1

    int[] .occluders(int[] origin, int[] direction, int distance, bool counted)
        int[] found := []
        for index := planes[]
            .consider_occluder(index, origin, direction, distance, counted, &found)
        int[] pending := if root >= 0 then [root] else []
        while #pending != 0
            last := int(#pending) - 1
            index := pending[last]
            pending = pending[0:<last]
            int[] interval := .test_node(index, origin, direction, 3, counted)
            if #interval == 0 or interval[0] >= distance
                continue
            node := nodes[index]
            if #node.objects > 0
                for object_index := node.objects[]
                    .consider_occluder(object_index, origin, direction, distance, counted, &found)
            else
                pending = pending.append(node.right).append(node.left)
        return found.sorted()

    (int[], int[]) camera(int qx, int qy)
        u := fixed.floor_div((qx - 2 * settings.width) * data.view[0], 2 * settings.width)
        v := fixed.floor_div((2 * settings.height - qy) * data.view[1], 2 * settings.height)
        direction := vector.add(vector.add(data.forward, vector.sc(data.right, u)), vector.sc(data.up, v))
        return (data.eye, vector.norm(direction))

    int[][] light_samples(int index, int[] point)
        scene.Light light := data.lights[index]
        intensity := light.values[-1]
        if light.kind == "sun"
            return [light.values[0:<3].concat([settings.far, intensity])]
        int[][] positions := []
        if light.kind == "area"
            k := light.values[9]
            for: j < k
                for: i < k
                    int[] position := []
                    for: axis < 3
                        position = position.append(light.values[axis] + fixed.floor_div((2 * i + 1) * light.values[axis + 3], 2 * k) + fixed.floor_div((2 * j + 1) * light.values[axis + 6], 2 * k))
                    positions = positions.append(position)
        else
            positions = [light.values[0:<3]]
        int[][] result := []
        for position := positions[]
            relative := vector.sub(position, point)
            result = result.append(vector.norm(relative).concat([vector.length(relative), fixed.floor_div(intensity, light.samples)]))
        return result

    int cone(int index, int[] direction)
        scene.Light light := data.lights[index]
        if light.kind != "spot"
            return 4096
        cosine := -vector.dot(direction, light.values[3:<6])
        if cosine <= light.values[6]
            return 0
        if cosine >= light.values[7]
            return 4096
        return fixed.floor_div((cosine - light.values[6]) * 4096, light.values[7] - light.values[6])

    int[] .local_color(Info &info, int[] direction, bool counted, Pixel &pixel)
        diffuse_sum := 0
        specular_sum := 0
        info.lighting = []
        info.illumination = 0
        scene.Material material := data.materials[data.objects[info.object_index].material]
        for: index < int(#data.lights)
            lit := 0
            diffuse := 0
            specular := 0
            for sample := light_samples(index, info.point)[]
                int[] toward := sample[0:<3]
                ndl := vector.dot(info.normal, toward)
                if ndl <= 0
                    if counted
                        light_counts[index][4] += 1
                    continue
                int factor := cone(index, toward)
                if factor == 0
                    if counted
                        light_counts[index][5] += 1
                    continue
                if counted
                    rays[3] += 1
                    pixel.rays += 1
                    light_counts[index][1] += 1
                int[] blockers := .occluders(info.point, toward, sample[3], counted)
                for object_index := blockers[]
                    factor = fixed.mul(factor, data.materials[data.objects[object_index].material].values[7])
                if factor == 0
                    if counted
                        light_counts[index][2] += 1
                    continue
                if counted and #blockers > 0
                    light_counts[index][3] += 1
                contribution := shading.phong(material.values, info.normal, toward, vector.neg(direction), ndl, sample[4], factor)
                lit += 1
                diffuse += contribution[0]
                specular += contribution[1]
            info.lighting = info.lighting.append([lit, diffuse, specular])
            if lit > 0
                info.illumination += 1
            diffuse_sum += diffuse
            specular_sum += specular
        int[] color := []
        for: axis < 3
            raw := fixed.floor_div(info.base[axis] * (data.ambient + diffuse_sum), 4096) + fixed.floor_div(255 * specular_sum, 4096)
            if counted and raw > 255
                clamped += 1
            color = color.append(minimum(raw, 255))
        return color

    (int[], Info) .trace(int[] origin, int[] direction, int kind, int depth, bool counted, Pixel &pixel, bool recording, string[] &records)
        ray_kinds := ["primary", "reflection", "refraction", "shadow"]
        if counted
            rays[kind] += 1
            depth_counts[depth] += 1
            pixel.rays += 1
            pixel.depth = maximum(pixel.depth, depth)
        if recording
            records = records.append("ray {ray_kinds[kind]} {depth} origin " + words(origin) + " direction " + words(direction))
        object_index, hit := .nearest(origin, direction, kind, counted)
        if object_index < 0
            if counted
                misses[kind] += 1
            if recording
                records = records.concat(["miss", "color " + words(data.background)])
            return (data.background, empty_info())
        scene.Object object := data.objects[object_index]
        scene.Material material := data.materials[object.material]
        point := vector.add(origin, vector.sc(direction, hit[0]))
        outward := intersect.outward(object.kind, object.geometry, point, direction, hit)
        front := vector.dot(outward, direction) <= 0
        normal := if front then outward else vector.neg(outward)
        info := Info(object_index, hit[0], point, normal, front, shading.base_color(material.values, material.checker, material.checker_size, point))
        if counted
            category := if kind == 0 then 0 else 1
            object_counts[object_index][category] += 1
        int[] local_value := .local_color(&info, direction, counted, &pixel)
        if recording
            records = records.append("hit {object.label} t {hit[0]} point " + words(point) + " normal " + words(normal) + " base " + words(info.base))
            for: j < int(#info.lighting)
                lighting := info.lighting[j]
                records = records.append("light {j + 1} lit {lighting[0]} of {data.lights[j].samples} diffuse {lighting[1]} specular {lighting[2]}")
            records = records.append("local " + words(local_value))
        color := local_value
        if depth < settings.max_depth and (material.values[6] > 0 or material.values[7] > 0)
            wr, wt, transmitted, internal := shading.refraction(material.values, direction, normal, front)
            if internal
                if counted
                    total_internal += 1
                if recording
                    records = records.append("total_internal_reflection")
            local_weight := 4096 - material.values[6] - material.values[7]
            if recording
                records = records.append("weights {local_weight} {wr} {wt}")
            reflected_color := [0, 0, 0]
            refracted_color := [0, 0, 0]
            if wr > 0
                result, child := .trace(point, shading.reflected(direction, normal), 1, depth + 1, counted, &pixel, recording, &records)
                reflected_color = result
            if wt > 0
                result, child := .trace(point, transmitted, 2, depth + 1, counted, &pixel, recording, &records)
                refracted_color = result
            color = shading.mix([local_value, reflected_color, refracted_color], [local_weight, wr, wt])
        if #data.fog > 0
            factor := 0
            if hit[0] >= data.fog[4]
                factor = 4096
            elif hit[0] > data.fog[3]
                factor = fixed.floor_div((hit[0] - data.fog[3]) * 4096, data.fog[4] - data.fog[3])
            color = shading.mix([color, data.fog[0:<3]], [4096 - factor, factor])
        if recording
            records = records.append("color " + words(color))
        return (color, info)

    void .render()
        for: y < settings.height
            for: x < settings.width
                pixel := Pixel(x, y)
                origin, direction := camera(4 * x + 2, 4 * y + 2)
                string[] records := []
                color, info := .trace(origin, direction, 0, 0, true, &pixel, false, &records)
                pixel.center = color
                pixel.color = color
                pixel.hit = info
                if info.object_index >= 0
                    pixel.label = data.objects[info.object_index].label
                    for: j < int(#info.lighting)
                        if info.lighting[j][0] > 0
                            light_counts[j][0] += 1
                pixels = pixels.append(pixel)
        for: index < int(#pixels)
            pixel := pixels[index]
            boundary := false
            for offset := [[0, -1], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]][]
                int x := pixel.x + offset[0]
                int y := pixel.y + offset[1]
                if 0 <= x < settings.width and 0 <= y < settings.height
                    other := pixels[y * settings.width + x]
                    difference := 0
                    for: axis < 3
                        difference = maximum(difference, absolute(pixel.center[axis] - other.center[axis]))
                    if pixel.label != other.label or difference > settings.contrast
                        boundary = true
            if not boundary
                continue
            supersampled += 1
            pixel.samples = 4
            sum_color := [0, 0, 0]
            for offset := [[1, 1], [3, 1], [1, 3], [3, 3]][]
                origin, direction := camera(4 * pixel.x + offset[0], 4 * pixel.y + offset[1])
                string[] records := []
                color, info := .trace(origin, direction, 0, 0, true, &pixel, false, &records)
                sum_color = sum_color + color
            pixel.color = [for value := sum_color[] then fixed.floor_div(value, 4)]
            pixels[index] = pixel

    int[] distance_range()
        low := -1
        high := -1
        for pixel := pixels[]
            if pixel.hit.object_index >= 0
                distance := pixel.hit.distance
                low = if low < 0 then distance else minimum(low, distance)
                high = if high < 0 then distance else maximum(high, distance)
        return if low < 0 then [] else [low, high]

    int[] mean_color(Pixel[] target)
        sum_color := [0, 0, 0]
        for pixel := target[]
            sum_color = sum_color + pixel.color
        return [for value := sum_color[] then fixed.floor_div(value, int(#target))]

    void netpbm(string name, string magic, int[][] values)
        rows := [magic, "{settings.width} {settings.height}", "255"]
        for: y < settings.height
            int[] fields := []
            for: x < settings.width
                fields = fields.concat(values[y * settings.width + x])
            rows = rows.append(words(fields))
        write_lines(name, rows)

    void character_map(string name, string[] values)
        string[] rows := []
        for: y < settings.height
            rows = rows.append(values[y * settings.width:<(y + 1) * settings.width].join(""))
        write_lines(name, rows)

    void write_images()
        int[] distances := distance_range()
        max_cost := 0
        for pixel := pixels[]
            max_cost = maximum(max_cost, pixel.rays)
        int[][] colors := []
        int[][] depths := []
        int[][] normals := []
        int[][] albedos := []
        int[][] costs := []
        string[] labels := []
        string[] lights := []
        string[] ray_depths := []
        for pixel := pixels[]
            colors = colors.append(pixel.color)
            costs = costs.append([fixed.floor_div(255 * pixel.rays, max_cost)])
            labels = labels.append(pixel.label)
            ray_depths = ray_depths.append(string(pixel.depth))
            hit := pixel.hit
            if hit.object_index < 0
                depths = depths.append([0])
                normals = normals.append([0, 0, 0])
                albedos = albedos.append([0, 0, 0])
                lights = lights.append(".")
            else
                value := if distances[0] == distances[1] then 255 else 255 - fixed.floor_div(235 * (hit.distance - distances[0]), distances[1] - distances[0])
                depths = depths.append([value])
                normal := [for component := hit.normal[] then maximum(0, minimum(255, fixed.floor_div((component + 4096) * 255, 2 * 4096)))]
                normals = normals.append(normal)
                albedos = albedos.append(hit.base)
                lights = lights.append(string(hit.illumination))
        netpbm("image.ppm", "P3", colors)
        netpbm("depth.pgm", "P2", depths)
        netpbm("normal.ppm", "P3", normals)
        netpbm("albedo.ppm", "P3", albedos)
        netpbm("cost.pgm", "P2", costs)
        character_map("object_map.txt", labels)
        character_map("light_map.txt", lights)
        character_map("ray_depth.txt", ray_depths)

    string[] statistics()
        ray_kinds := ["primary", "reflection", "refraction", "shadow"]
        rows := ["image {settings.width} {settings.height}", "supersampled {supersampled}"]
        ray_line := "rays"
        miss_line := "misses"
        ray_total := 0
        for: kind < 4
            ray_line += " {ray_kinds[kind]} {rays[kind]}"
            ray_total += rays[kind]
            if kind < 3
                miss_line += " {ray_kinds[kind]} {misses[kind]}"
        rows = rows.concat([ray_line + " total {ray_total}", miss_line, "depth " + words(depth_counts)])
        for: kind < 4
            rows = rows.append("tests {ray_kinds[kind]} nodes {tests[kind][0]} objects {tests[kind][1]}")
        rows = rows.concat(["total_internal_reflection {total_internal}", "clamped {clamped}"])
        int[] distances := distance_range()
        rows = rows.append("distance " + (if #distances == 0 then "none" else words(distances)))
        max_cost := 0
        histogram := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        for pixel := pixels[]
            max_cost = maximum(max_cost, pixel.rays)
            brightness := fixed.floor_div(299 * pixel.color[0] + 587 * pixel.color[1] + 114 * pixel.color[2], 1000)
            histogram[brightness / 32] += 1
        rows = rows.concat(["max_pixel_rays {max_cost}", "mean " + words(mean_color(pixels)), "histogram " + words(histogram)])
        for node := nodes[]
            role := "inner"
            if #node.objects > 0
                string labels := [for index := node.objects[] then data.objects[index].label].join("")
                role = "leaf " + labels
            rows = rows.append("node {node.depth} {role} box " + words(node.low) + " " + words(node.high) + " visits {node.visits}")
        for: index < int(#data.objects)
            scene.Object object := data.objects[index]
            chosen := [for pixel := pixels[] if pixel.label == object.label then pixel]
            box := "none"
            color := "none"
            if #chosen > 0
                xmin := chosen[0].x
                ymin := chosen[0].y
                xmax := xmin
                ymax := ymin
                for pixel := chosen[]
                    xmin = minimum(xmin, pixel.x)
                    ymin = minimum(ymin, pixel.y)
                    xmax = maximum(xmax, pixel.x)
                    ymax = maximum(ymax, pixel.y)
                box = "{xmin} {ymin} {xmax} {ymax}"
                color = words(mean_color(chosen))
            counts := object_counts[index]
            rows = rows.append("object {object.label} {object.kind} primary {counts[0]} secondary {counts[1]} shadow {counts[2]} pixels {#chosen} box {box} color {color}")
        for: index < int(#data.lights)
            scene.Light light := data.lights[index]
            counts := light_counts[index]
            rows = rows.append("light {index + 1} {light.kind} samples {light.samples} pixels {counts[0]} shadow_rays {counts[1]} blocked {counts[2]} attenuated {counts[3]} backfacing {counts[4]} outside {counts[5]}")
        return rows

    string[] .queries()
        string[] rows := []
        input := read_lines("input/queries.txt")
        for: number < int(#input)
            line := input[number]
            rows = rows.append("query {number + 1} {line}")
            fields := line.split(" ")
            kind := fields[0]
            if kind == "object"
                for: index < int(#data.objects)
                    scene.Object object := data.objects[index]
                    if object.label != fields[1]
                        continue
                    result := "{object.kind} material {data.materials[object.material].name}"
                    if #object_bounds[index] == 0
                        result += " bounds none leaf none"
                    else
                        result += " bounds " + words(object_bounds[index][0]) + " " + words(object_bounds[index][1]) + " leaf {leaf_depths[index]}"
                    rows = rows.append(result)
                    break
                continue
            values := [for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then scene.integer(text)]
            if kind == "pixel"
                pixel := pixels[values[1] * settings.width + values[0]]
                distance := if pixel.hit.object_index < 0 then "none" else string(pixel.hit.distance)
                rows = rows.append("label {pixel.label} distance {distance} color " + words(pixel.color) + " samples {pixel.samples} rays {pixel.rays}")
            elif kind == "trace"
                origin, direction := camera(4 * values[0] + 2, 4 * values[1] + 2)
                pixel := Pixel(0, 0)
                color, info := .trace(origin, direction, 0, 0, false, &pixel, true, &rows)
            elif kind == "ray"
                pixel := Pixel(0, 0)
                color, info := .trace(values[0:<3], vector.norm(values[3:<6]), 0, 0, false, &pixel, true, &rows)
            elif kind == "visible"
                relative := vector.sub(values, data.eye)
                direction := vector.norm(relative)
                int[] blockers := .occluders(data.eye, direction, vector.length(relative) - settings.epsilon, false)
                visibility := if #blockers == 0 then "yes" else "no"
                object_index, hit := .nearest(data.eye, direction, 0, false)
                rows = rows.append(if object_index < 0 then "{visibility} first none" else "{visibility} first {data.objects[object_index].label} t {hit[0]}")
            elif kind == "shadow"
                for: index < int(#data.lights)
                    factor_sum := 0
                    found := [for j := (0:<int(#data.objects))[] then false]
                    for sample := light_samples(index, values)[]
                        int[] direction := sample[0:<3]
                        int factor := cone(index, direction)
                        int[] blockers := .occluders(values, direction, sample[3], false)
                        for object_index := blockers[]
                            found[object_index] = true
                            factor = fixed.mul(factor, data.materials[data.objects[object_index].material].values[7])
                        factor_sum += factor
                    string labels := [for j := (0:<int(#data.objects))[] if found[j] then data.objects[j].label].join("")
                    rows = rows.append("light {index + 1} factor {factor_sum} occluders " + (if labels == "" then "none" else labels))
            elif kind == "region"
                Pixel[] chosen := []
                for: values[1] <= y <= values[3]
                    for: values[0] <= x <= values[2]
                        chosen = chosen.append(pixels[y * settings.width + x])
                rows = rows.append("pixels {#chosen} mean " + words(mean_color(chosen)))
                string[] labels := [for object := data.objects[] then object.label].append(".")
                for label := labels[]
                    count := 0
                    for pixel := chosen[]
                        if pixel.label == label
                            count += 1
                    if count > 0
                        rows = rows.append("label {label} {count}")
        return rows

void run()
    renderer := Renderer(scene.read_scene(), read_settings())
    .renderer.prepare()
    .renderer.render()
    renderer.write_images()
    write_lines("stats.txt", renderer.statistics())
    queries := .renderer.queries()
    write_lines("queries.txt", queries)

run()

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

class Material(string name, int[] values)
    int[] checker := []
    checker_size := 0

class Object(string label, string kind, int material, int[] geometry)

class Light(string kind, int[] values, int samples)

class Scene()
    eye := [0, 0, 0]
    forward := [0, 0, 0]
    right := [0, 0, 0]
    up := [0, 0, 0]
    view := [0, 0]
    background := [0, 0, 0]
    ambient := 0
    int[] fog := []
    Material[] materials := []
    Object[] objects := []
    Light[] lights := []

int material_index(Material[] values, string name)
    for: j < int(#values)
        if values[j].name == name
            return j
    return -1

Scene read_scene()
    result := Scene()
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/scene.txt"))
    for row := content.split(NL)[]
        if row == "" or row.starts_with("#")
            continue
        fields := row.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        if kind == "material"
            values := [for text := fields[2:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
            result.materials = result.materials.append(Material(fields[1], values))
        elif kind == "checker"
            index := material_index(result.materials, fields[1])
            result.materials[index].checker = [integer(fields[2]), integer(fields[3]), integer(fields[4])]
            result.materials[index].checker_size = integer(fields[5])
        elif kind == "sphere" or kind == "plane" or kind == "box"
            geometry := [for text := fields[3:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
            if kind == "plane"
                normal := vector.norm(geometry[3:<6])
                for: j < 3
                    geometry[j + 3] = normal[j]
            result.objects = result.objects.append(Object(fields[1], kind, material_index(result.materials, fields[2]), geometry))
        else
            values := [for text := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
            if kind == "point" or kind == "spot" or kind == "sun" or kind == "area"
                samples := 1
                if kind == "sun"
                    direction := vector.norm(vector.neg(values[0:<3]))
                    for: j < 3
                        values[j] = direction[j]
                elif kind == "spot"
                    direction := vector.norm(values[3:<6])
                    for: j < 3
                        values[j + 3] = direction[j]
                elif kind == "area"
                    samples = values[9] * values[9]
                result.lights = result.lights.append(Light(kind, values, samples))
            elif kind == "eye"
                result.eye = values
            elif kind == "forward"
                result.forward = values
            elif kind == "right"
                result.right = values
            elif kind == "up"
                result.up = values
            elif kind == "view"
                result.view = values
            elif kind == "background"
                result.background = values
            elif kind == "ambient"
                result.ambient = values[0]
            elif kind == "fog"
                result.fog = values
    return result

import fixed = "./fixed_point.qui"
import vector = "./vector3.qui"

int[] base_color(int[] material, int[] checker, int checker_size, int[] point)
    if checker_size > 0
        parity := fixed.floor_div(point[0], checker_size) + fixed.floor_div(point[1], checker_size) + fixed.floor_div(point[2], checker_size)
        if parity % 2 != 0
            return checker
    return material[0:<3]

int[] phong(int[] material, int[] normal, int[] light, int[] view, int ndl, int intensity, int factor)
    effective := fixed.mul(intensity, factor)
    diffuse := fixed.mul(fixed.mul(material[3], ndl), effective)
    reflected_light := vector.sub(vector.sc(normal, 2 * ndl), light)
    rv := vector.dot(reflected_light, view)
    specular := 0
    if rv > 0
        power := 4096
        for: j < material[5]
            power = fixed.mul(power, rv)
        specular = fixed.mul(fixed.mul(material[4], power), effective)
    return [diffuse, specular]

int[] reflected(int[] direction, int[] normal)
    return vector.norm(vector.sub(direction, vector.sc(normal, 2 * vector.dot(direction, normal))))

(int, int, int[], bool) refraction(int[] material, int[] direction, int[] normal, bool front)
    wr := material[6]
    wt := material[7]
    if wt == 0
        return (wr, wt, [], false)
    eta := if front then fixed.floor_div(4096 * 4096, material[8]) else material[8]
    cosine := -vector.dot(direction, normal)
    discriminant := 4096 * 4096 - fixed.floor_div(fixed.mul(eta, eta) * (4096 * 4096 - cosine * cosine), 4096)
    if discriminant < 0
        return (wr + wt, 0, [], true)
    transmitted := vector.norm(vector.add(vector.sc(direction, eta), vector.sc(normal, fixed.mul(eta, cosine) - fixed.isqrt(discriminant))))
    r0 := fixed.floor_div((material[8] - 4096) * 4096, material[8] + 4096)
    reflectance := fixed.mul(r0, r0)
    x := 4096 - (if cosine < 4096 then cosine else 4096)
    power := 4096
    for: j < 5
        power = fixed.mul(power, x)
    fresnel := reflectance + fixed.mul(4096 - reflectance, power)
    transfer := fixed.mul(material[7], fresnel)
    return (wr + transfer, wt - transfer, transmitted, false)

int[] mix(int[][] colors, int[] weights)
    result := [0, 0, 0]
    for: j < int(#colors)
        for: axis < 3
            result[axis] += fixed.floor_div(colors[j][axis] * weights[j], 4096)
    return result

import fixed = "./fixed_point.qui"

int[] add(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first + second

int[] sub(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first - second

int[] neg(int[] value)
    return [for item := value[] then -item]

int dot(int[] first, int[] second)
    return fixed.floor_div(first[0] * second[0] + first[1] * second[1] + first[2] * second[2], 4096)

int[] sc(int[] value, int factor)
    return [for item := value[] then fixed.floor_div(item * factor, 4096)]

int length(int[] value)
    return fixed.isqrt(value[0] * value[0] + value[1] * value[1] + value[2] * value[2])

int[] norm(int[] value)
    magnitude := length(value)
    return [for item := value[] then fixed.floor_div(item * 4096, magnitude)]
